# Rows to Riches

> A free browser idle (incremental) game about data engineering and corporate life. Click INSERT, buy data sources, survive OKRs and all-hands, and prestige through four layers from a CSV on localhost to cataloging the universe. No ads, no account needed, plays offline. By Drumandbytes.

## Pages

- [Play the game](https://rowstoriches.drumandbytes.dev/): the game itself (requires JavaScript)
- [How to play](https://rowstoriches.drumandbytes.dev/how-to-play/): the loop, upgrades, schema, OKRs, shortcuts, FAQ
- [Privacy and fair play](https://rowstoriches.drumandbytes.dev/privacy/): saves, cloud account codes, anonymous stats, leaderboards
